about: Every authority this platform NAMES, as a row: the publisher's page, the date it was read, who read it, its status and what replaced it. A row is entered by whoever read the page, in a round. Nothing fetches a page on a timer; a row is current for `review_days` after it was read and is shown as not recently checked after that. A name the code uses with no row here fails scripts/sources_check.py.

rows.says: Nature Human Behaviour, 28 October 2024. A preregistered meta-analysis of 106 experiments and 370 effect sizes: on average human-AI combinations did worse than the better of the two alone (g = -0.23); losses in deciding, gains in creating content; gains where the human alone was the stronger. NOT READ: the paper beyond its abstract.
